uncited: **Level Queues**: An array of queues, one for each level of the octree.
**SVO Node**: Represents a voxel or internal node.
**Partitioning**: Partition the triangle mesh according to subgrids of the high-resolution 3D voxel grid in a streaming manner by testing each triangle against the bounding box of every subgrid.
**Subgrid Sizing**: Determine subgrid size by regularly subdividing the high-resolution voxel grid until a subgrid fits in available memory.
For each subgrid, consume its corresponding triangle mesh partition in a streaming manner.
Voxelize triangles using the 6-separability surface voxelization variant of Huang et al. [1998].
**Initialize**: Create an array of empty queues, one for each level of the octree (from leaf level up to root level).
**Create Parent Nodes**: When a parent node's children (all nodes in the current level's queue) are processed, create an internal node with the parent's Morton code.
Store this internal node in the queue of the parent's level.
Write all non-empty nodes currently in the child's queue to the output.
**Repeat**: Repeat reading leaf nodes and creating parent nodes level by level until the root is processed.
- **Time Complexity**: Not given in the sources.
- **Measured Performance**: Implemented in C++ requiring approximately 1000 lines of code.
Tested on a Dell Precision T7500 workstation (Intel Xeon X5650 CPU, 7200 RPM SATA II disk).
